Version 1.0.2 of trollgent

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Documentation and functional behavior remain unchanged from version 1.0.0.
- No user or system impact; version bump only.

No user-facing changes detected in this version.

- Version updated with no functional or documentation changes
- No file modifications or content updates present

- Initial release of trollgent, version 1.0.0.
- Provides a mechanism to interrupt internal agent reasoning loops using troll-style reset messages from the Agent Lounge API.
- Automatically self-invokes when repetitive thinking or planning loops are detected.
- Includes clear criteria for invocation and fallback handling if the API is unavailable.
- Designed as a cognitive reset tool for agents, not as end-user output.
